minutes.headline: Select Board tabled its special event permit policy to rework the definition, and held a closed session on Lake Shirley litigation.
minutes.summary: The board heard long public comment from Lake Shirley residents about conservation order-of-conditions and a conflict-of-interest concern, and from residents on Holman Street events. It approved a Unitil pole location and a one-day wine and malt license, and debated special event permit guidelines until the motion was withdrawn and a July workshop was proposed. It voted to invite talent bank applicants into reappointments, ratified seasonal beach appointments, released old executive session minutes, and went into executive session on litigation.

suggested_reports.title: Special event permits
suggested_reports.question: What would special event permitting cost applicants and the town?

what_happened.line: The Select Board withdrew a motion to adopt special event permit guidelines and will rework the definition for a July workshop.
Lake Shirley residents spent long public comment on a dispute with the Conservation Commission over an order of conditions and an alleged conflict of interest.
The board approved a Unitil pole location on Pine Grove Road, with one member voting no, and a one-day wine and malt license for June 8.
The board voted to invite talent bank applicants to interview in the Conservation Commission reappointment process.
The board released listed executive session minutes, then went into executive session on litigation by roll call vote.

why_it_matters: Special event rules decide what events, such as those on Holman Street, may be held and what notice abutters get, and the definition is still unsettled.
Conservation Commission seats and orders of conditions affect lakefront owners, and the reappointment interviews change how residents can apply for those seats.

A state earmark for the Eagle House senior center, to be reimbursed against expenses by June 30, will affect free cash, and higher supply rates for electricity and gas from December 1 touch the FY20 budget.
watch_next: The July workshop on the special event permit definition, with the date still to be set with the town manager.
The June 11 workshop to set board and town manager goals, and the June 18 agenda with the July and August meeting schedule.

reconciliation.what: Our minutes against the minutes the town published. caption_error = the same fact the captions rendered badly, resolved by the official reading shown beside the as-heard one; discrepancy = a substantive difference, flagged and not resolved. Neither record is treated as the referee.
reconciliation.summary: The two records agree on the main votes (pole petition, Dragonfly license, talent bank invitation, withdrawn event policy) and on most figures. They differ on who the town manager is and on the executive session vote, which only our minutes record.
